description.value:
You inscribe a diamond-shaped seal of stored chakra and healing energy on your forehead over a downtime activity (1 hour of meditation, requires uninterrupted rest). The seal remains inactive but visible on your forehead until you activate it as a free action.

While active, you gain fast healing equal to half your level (minimum 3), regain expended spell slots of rank 2 or lower at the start of each of your turns (one slot per turn), and treat all critical hits against you as normal hits. The seal deactivates after 10 minutes; you cannot re-form it until you complete a full long rest.

This is Tsunade's signature, used in her final battle with Madara.

Heightened (8th) Fast healing increases to your level; the regained-slot rank threshold rises to 4.

system.requirements: you have 1 hour of uninterrupted downtime to inscribe the seal
